Allah will have those with a mustard seed's weight of faith taken out of Hell, charred, and they will revive in a river like seeds sprouting by a flood channel.
The Prophet was shown the Fire, most of whose dwellers were women; asked whether they disbelieved in Allah, he said they were ungrateful to husbands and for kindness.
Whoever declared that none but Allah is worshipped, with good in his heart weighing even a barley grain, wheat grain or atom, will be taken out of Hell.
During the eclipse prayer the Prophet was shown the Hellfire, and said he had never seen a more horrible sight.
The Prophet calls a man claiming Islam one of the Fire; he fights fiercely, then kills himself when wounded, and the Prophet announces that only a Muslim enters Paradise.
Hell's breaths cause severe heat and cold, and fever is from its heat; its fire is seventy times ours, and one who enjoined good but did evil circles in it.
The Prophet recites from the pulpit the verse in which the people of Hell cry to Malik to have his Lord make an end of them.
Allah will speak to each person on Resurrection Day without an interpreter, the Fire facing him; shield yourselves from the Fire even with half a date or a good word.
The Fire's least punished man has embers under his feet boiling his brain, as Abu Talib may; some come out burnt through intercession; shield yourselves even with half a date.
Hell will keep asking for more until the Lord puts His Foot over it, and it says 'Enough, enough' by His Power and Honour as its sides draw together.
